profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a London-based company founded in 2017 that describes itself as the number one AI video platform for business. Per its site, the platform lets users create and manage professional video at scale, hold two-way conversations with Interactive Avatars, and build its video technology into their own products. The company says its AI Video Generator produces videos without mics, cameras, actors, or studios, and that content can be created from a description, a PowerPoint, a document, or a link, with a script, scenes, and an avatar presenter generated as a draft. Users can choose from stock avatars, design their own with Avatar Builder, or present as themselves with a Personal Avatar.

The site states that Synthesia is used by 90%+ of the Fortune 100 to communicate, train, and upskill teams, and that it supports video creation in 140+ languages and translation or dubbing in 160+ languages, including 1-Click Translation and AI Dubbing in the original speaker's voice. Other listed features include AI Voice Cloning, AI Screen Recorder, Script to Video, PowerPoint to Video, Roleplay Sessions for practice and conversational surveys, and an AI Video Assistant. The company says its Basic plan is free with no credit card required and includes 500 credits a month, enough for up to 10 minutes of video or 10 minutes of AI Dubbing. Developer resources listed on the site include API, Interactive Avatars API, Dubbing API, AI Video Assistant API, and MCP documentation.

On compliance, Synthesia says it is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and ISO 42001 certified, GDPR compliant, and offers EU data residency, with SSO and SCIM for enterprise access control. It says every video goes through content moderation and that no one's likeness becomes an avatar without explicit consent. The site also notes that some content is generated using artificial intelligence and labeled in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements. Synthesia is tracked as a video generation and editing product, with the noted risk area of AI avatars and likeness or consent.
